title: Allabariga Rabitaanka ah
intro: Waqtigii imtixaanada rabbaaniga ah, nafta waxaa loogu yeeray ficilka ugu dambeeya ee is-hoosaysiinta. Markii lagu soo koray dhul madhan, qofkani wuxuu ku koray iimaan iyo dulqaad. Marka aragtidu amarto allabaryo, ma aysan ruxmin. Sheekadoodu waa tiir muhiim ah oo cibaado ah.
clues: Waxaan ahaa jawaabta ducada nebi weyn oo la sugayay muddo dheer.
Aniga iyo hooyaday waxaan ku harnay dooxo cidlo ah oo aan haysanno oo keliya quudin timir iyo biyo ah.
Waxaan ku soo koray inaan noqdo nebi caan ku ah runta iyo dulqaadka.
Waxaan aabahay ka caawiyay kor u qaadidda aasaaska guri barakeysan oo loo hibeeyay Alle.
Markii aabbahay ii sheegay riyo aan ku qalo, waxaan ugu jawaabay, 'Samee sida lagu faray.'
Ilaahay baa ii sharfay is-hoosaysiintaydii isagoo samada ka soo diray wan si uu ii madaxfurto.

arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast." (37:102)
